srList.sentence: Coverslips were then placed cell-side down to ensure that samples were completely immersed in 50 mL of hybridization solution 2 x SSC , 10 ( vv ) formamide , 10 ( wv ) dextran sulfate , 0.5 ( wv ) BSA in PBS containing 250 nM CDK6 3UTR or negative control ( LacZ ) Cy3-labelled FISH probes ( Generay biotechnology ) and HNRNPA2B1 antibodies ( diluted at 1300 , Santa Cruz ) inside of a humidified Petri dish for 4 hours at 37degC .
